column1: # Port hooks for Coded Arms (ULES-00124): guest address of a (non-branch) instruction, then the
# host function (src/psp/game_hooks.cpp) called right after it executes. Found with the store
0889bad4  ca_hook_player_view   # entry of the per-frame view update: s3 = view object, s2 = input
08879ff8  ca_hook_frame_interval # SetFrameInterval(settings, a1 = vblanks per frame), after its first instruction
08837f7c  ca_hook_frame_work_done # main loop frame wait: entry (s0 = timing object)
08837fac  ca_hook_frame_start   # main loop frame wait: exit (the vblank counter is reset)
0890247c  ca_hook_dev_loadout_mission # mission start: s16 loadout[5] at sp+36, a2 = loadout[1] (dev mode)
08900e18  ca_hook_dev_loadout_respawn # loadout again: s16 loadout[5] at sp+20, a1 = loadout[0] (dev mode)
